description: The boss room after Room 14: spikes burst up from a 4x4 floor grid for 60 s.

scenarios.name: Spike room (boss)
scenarios.summary: Dodge the floor spikes for a minute
scenarios.description: The map's own sequence, from its logic_auto (the soundscape trigger on at +3 s, Rod.Music from +5 s, both playing when you arrive): math_boss_counter hits 15 on Room 14 (the 15th room spawned, math_total_counter starts at -1), so room_maker_relay_boss spawns roomBossTemplate at room_reset_maker_point and Room 14's door teleport drops you at human_teleport 1 s later. boss_start (the line 250 u ahead) triggers boss_start_relay: the map music stops, at +7 boss_sides_hurt closes the entrance strip behind you (999, humans) and Rod.lab plays, at +11 the face lights up with Rod.bell, boss music at +15. boss_attack_timer (enabled +13, every 4 s, 3 s from +20, 2 s from +40) snaps (Rod.snap +0.5 s) and boss_attack_case picks one of 3 patterns: rows 1 + 3, the X, or the outer ring. Each spike rises 1.15 s after the pick (Rod.crystal), its attack_hurt (999) is live once fully up and gone 1.1 s later. Win when boss_end_relay fires (+60).
